verses.html: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.
verses.text: O praise the LORD, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

verses.html: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Praise ye the LORD.
